parole.significato: A hill or mound, originally and especially in the Middle East, over or consisting of the ruins of ancient settlements.
parole.testo: From Arabic تَلّ (tall, “hill, elevation”) or Hebrew תֵּל (tél, “hill”), from Proto-Semitic *tall- (“hill”).
